en: You shouldn't expect\rmachine guns to do\rmuch damage against\rnon-infantry units.
cz: Necekej, ze kulomety\rnadelaji velkou skodu\rjednotkam jinym\rnez pechote.

en: Bazookas are effective\ragainst non-infantry\rground units. They're\requal to tank rounds.
cz: Bazuky jsou ucinne proti\rpozemnim jednotkam mimo\rpechotu. Vyrovnaji se\rtankovym granatum.

en: M guns get used when\rbazooka ammo runs out.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Kulomet se pouzije, kdyz\rdojde munice do bazuky.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: M guns get used when\rcannon ammo runs out.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Kulomet se pouzije, kdyz\rdojde munice do kanonu.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: The cannon is fairly\reffective against ships.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Kanon je proti lodim\rdocela ucinny.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: Machine guns get used\ron non-infantry ground\runits when cannon\rammo runs out.
cz: Kulomety se pouziji proti\rpozemnim jednotkam mimo\rpechotu, kdyz dojde\rmunice do kanonu.

en: Rockets work very well\ragainst foot soldiers.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Rakety funguji skvele\rproti pesim vojakum.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: Rockets are powerful\ragainst these units.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Rakety jsou proti temto\rjednotkam velmi silne.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: The symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Symbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: The Vulcan cannon\rhas overpowering\rfirepower against\rfoot soldiers.
cz: Vulkan ma proti\rpesim vojakum\rdrtivou palebnou\rsilu.

en: The Vulcan cannon is\radequate against non-\rinfantry units and weak\ragainst tank units.
cz: Vulkan je slusny proti\rjednotkam mimo pechotu\ra slaby proti\rtankovym jednotkam.

en: The Vulcan cannon is\rstrong against copters.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Vulkan je silny proti\rvrtulnikum.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: Bombs can generally\rdestroy entire units of\rfoot soldiers regardless\rof defensive cover.
cz: Bomby obvykle znici cele\rjednotky pesich vojaku\rbez ohledu na to,\rjaky maji kryt.

en: Bombs cause immense\rdamage to non-\rinfantry units, too.
cz: Bomby delaji obrovske\rskody i jednotkam\rmimo pechotu.

en: M guns get used when\rmissiles run out.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Kulomet se pouzije, kdyz\rdojdou rakety.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: The cannon is strong\ragainst foot soldiers.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Kanon je silny proti\rpesim vojakum.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: The cannon has a high\rfirepower rating\ragainst non-infantry\rground units.
cz: Kanon ma vysokou\rpalebnou silu proti\rpozemnim jednotkam\rmimo pechotu.

en: This cannon is extremely\rstrong against ships.\rThe symbol on the unit\rshows hit potential.
cz: Tento kanon je proti\rlodim nesmirne silny.\rSymbol na jednotce ukazuje\rsanci na zasah.

en: This is the unit's\rmovement range. It can\rcover most terrain at a\rmovement cost of one.
cz: Toto je dosah pohybu\rjednotky. Vetsinu terenu\rzvladne za cenu pohybu\rjedna.

en: This unit travels on\rtires. This is its\rmovement range.
cz: Tato jednotka jezdi na\rpneumatikach. Toto je\rjeji dosah pohybu.

en: This unit travels on\rtreads. This is its\rmovement range.
cz: Tato jednotka jezdi na\rpasech. Toto je\rjeji dosah pohybu.

en: This is an air unit.\rTerrain does not\raffect its movement\rrange.
cz: Toto je vzdusna jednotka.\rTeren neovlivnuje\rjeji dosah\rpohybu.

en: This is a naval unit.\rThis is its movement\rrange across open\rwater and reefs.
cz: Toto je namorni jednotka.\rToto je jeji dosah pohybu\rpres otevrenou vodu\ra utesy.

en: This is a transport\runit's movement\rrange. These units\rcan move over reefs.
cz: Toto je dosah pohybu\rtransportni jednotky.\rTyto jednotky umi\rprojet pres utesy.

en: This is the unit's\rvision range. This\rincreases when the\runit climbs a mountain.
cz: Toto je dohled jednotky.\rZvysi se, kdyz\rjednotka vystoupa\rdo hor.

en: This is the unit's\rvision range.
cz: Toto je dohled\rjednotky.

en: This is the current fuel\ramount. The unit can no\rlonger move when all the\rfuel is used.
cz: Toto je soucasny stav\rpaliva. Kdyz palivo dojde,\rjednotka se uz nemuze\rpohnout.

en: This is the current fuel\ramount. It's used at 5\runits per turn. Units\rcrash when out of fuel.
cz: Toto je soucasny stav\rpaliva. Spotreba je 5\rza tah. Bez paliva se\rjednotka zriti.

en: This is the current fuel\ramount. It's used at 2\runits per turn. Units\rcrash when out of fuel.
cz: Toto je soucasny stav\rpaliva. Spotreba je 2\rza tah. Bez paliva se\rjednotka zriti.

en: This is the current fuel\ramount. It's used at 1\runit per turn. Units\rsink when out of fuel.
cz: Toto je soucasny stav\rpaliva. Spotreba je 1\rza tah. Bez paliva se\rjednotka potopi.

en: The symbol on the unit\rindicates the\rpotential to hit\rthis unit type.
cz: Symbol na jednotce\rukazuje sanci na\rzasah tohoto\rtypu jednotky.

en: The symbol on the unit\rindicates the\rpotential to hit\rthis unit type.
cz: Symbol na jednotce\rukazuje sanci na\rzasah tohoto\rtypu jednotky.

en: The symbol on the unit\rindicates the\rpotential to hit\rthis unit type.
cz: Symbol na jednotce\rukazuje sanci na\rzasah tohoto\rtypu jednotky.

en: The secondary weapon\ris the machine gun.
cz: Druhotna zbran\rje kulomet.

en: Here you must capture the enemy\rHQ or defeat all the enemy units.\f
cz: Tady musite obsadit neprateleske\rHQ nebo znicit vsechny jednotky.\f

en: To win here, capture the enemy HQ\ror defeat all the enemy troops.\fGood luck and move out!\f
cz: K vitezstvi obsadte neprateleske HQ\rnebo znicte vsechny jeho jednotky.\fHodne stesti a vyrazte!\f

en: Survive for 5 days to win.\fDon't let your units be destroyed or\ryour HQ be captured during that time.\f
cz: Vyhrajete, kdyz prezijete 5 dnu.\fNenechte znicit sve jednotky ani\robsadit sve HQ.\f

en: Win this battle by capturing the enemy\rHQ or defeating all the enemy units.\fDon't let Olaf win!\f
cz: Bitvu vyhrajete obsazenim HQ\rnebo znicenim vsech jednotek.\fNenechte Olafa vyhrat!\f

en: For victory, capture the enemy\rHQ or defeat all the enemy units.\f
cz: K vitezstvi obsadte neprateleske\rHQ nebo znicte vsechny jednotky.\f

en: Defeat all the enemy forces or\rcapture the enemy HQ to win here.\f
cz: Znicte vsechny nepratelske sily\rnebo obsadte jejich HQ.\f

en: The army that captures 12\rproperties first, wins! Get moving!\f
cz: Vyhrava armada, ktera prvni\robsadi 12 budov! Do toho!\f

en: Capture the enemy HQ or defeat\rall the enemy forces for victory!\fGood luck!\f
cz: Obsadte neprateleske HQ nebo\rznicte vsechny jeho sily!\fHodne stesti!\f

en: Defeat all the enemy forces or\rcapture the enemy HQ to win here.\fEither way will work!\f
cz: Znicte vsechny nepratelske sily\rnebo obsadte jejich HQ.\fOboji funguje!\f

en: Capture the enemy HQ or vanquish\rall the enemy troops to win.\fIt'll be a tough battle,\rbut you can do it!\f
cz: Obsadte neprateleske HQ nebo\rporazte vsechny jeho vojaky.\fBude to tvrda bitva,\rale zvladnete to!\f

en: The army that captures 15\rproperties first, wins! Get moving!\f
cz: Vyhrava armada, ktera prvni\robsadi 15 budov! Do toho!\f

en: The army that captures 16\rproperties first, wins! Move out!\f
cz: Vyhrava armada, ktera prvni\robsadi 16 budov! Vyrazte!\f

en: You need to capture a majority of\rthe open properties to win.\fLet's see... OK, you need 12\rproperties. Get going!\f
cz: K vitezstvi musite obsadit vetsinu\rvolnych budov.\fTakze... ano, potrebujete\r12 budov. Do toho!\f

en: Defeat all enemy forces or capture\rthe enemy HQ to win here. Good luck!\f
cz: Znicte vsechny nepratelske sily nebo\robsadte jejich HQ. Hodne stesti!\f

en: You need to capture a majority of\rthe open properties to win.\fThat means you need to capture\r15 properties.\f
cz: K vitezstvi musite obsadit vetsinu\rvolnych budov.\fTo znamena, ze musite obsadit\r15 budov.\f

en: You have fifteen days\rto rout the enemy.\fIf you can't do this within\rthe time limit, you lose.\f
cz: Mate patnact dnu na to,\rabyste rozdrtili nepritele.\fPokud to nestihnete\rv limitu, prohravate.\f

en: You can win by routing all the enemy\runits or by capturing the enemy HQ.\fGood luck!\f
cz: Vyhrajete rozdrcenim vsech nepratel\rnebo obsazenim jejich HQ.\fHodne stesti!\f

en: To win, defeat all the enemy troops.\rGo get 'em!\f
cz: K vitezstvi znicte vsechny vojaky.\rJdete na ne!\f

en: Rout all enemy units or capture the\renemy HQ for victory.\fThis is a tough opponent,\rbut you can win!\f
cz: Rozdrtte vsechny jednotky nebo\robsadte neprateleske HQ.\fTohle je tvrdy souper,\rale muzete vyhrat!\f

en: Drake is a powerful opponent, but\ryou can defeat him!\fRout his forces or capture his HQ\rfor victory.\f
cz: Drake je silny souper, ale\rmuzete ho porazit!\fRozdrtte jeho sily nebo obsadte\rjeho HQ.\f

en: Rout all the enemy units or capture\rthe enemy HQ to win.\fKeep up the good work.\rI know you can win!\f
cz: Rozdrtte vsechny jednotky nebo\robsadte neprateleske HQ.\fJde vam to skvele.\rVim, ze to zvladnete!\f

en: Capture the enemy HQ or defeat all\rthe enemy units to win.\fWork with your allies to rout Sturm!\f
cz: Obsadte neprateleske HQ nebo\rznicte vsechny jeho jednotky.\fSe spojenci rozdrtte Sturma!\f

en: You must rout all the enemy units or\rcapture the enemy HQ to win.\f
cz: Musite rozdrtit vsechny jednotky\rnebo obsadit neprateleske HQ.\f

en: An all-around\rcompetent CO.\rGood luck follows her\rwherever she goes.
cz: Vsestranne schopna\rvelitelka. Stesti ji\rprovazi vsude,\rkam prijde.

en: \rMay become even\rluckier than normal.
cz: \rMuze mit jeste\rvetsi stesti nez jindy.

en: No real weaknesses.\rReady to battle where-\rever and whenever.
cz: Zadne skutecne slabiny.\rPripraven bojovat\rkdykoli a kdekoli.

en: \rRestores 2 HP\rto all units.
cz: \rObnovi 2 HP\rvsem jednotkam.

en: Direct combat units\rhave high firepower.\rDistance units are\rweak and have small\rattack ranges.
cz: Jednotky na blizko maji\rvysokou palebnou silu.\rJednotky na dalku jsou\rslabe a maji maly\rdostrel.

en: \rIncreases all\rabilities of direct\rcombat units.
cz: \rZvysi vsechny\rschopnosti jednotek\rbojujicich na blizko.

en: Strong in the snow,\rweak in the rain.\rA solid CO of above-\raverage ability.
cz: Silny ve snehu,\rslaby v desti.\rSolidni velitel s\rnadprumernymi schopnostmi.

en: \rCauses it to snow\rcreating favorable\rconditions for his units.
cz: \rPrivola snezeni, ktere\rvytvori vyhodne\rpodminky pro jeho jednotky.

en: Distance weapons have\ran extended attack\rrange. However, direct\rcombat units are weak.
cz: Zbrane na dalku maji\rvetsi dostrel. Jednotky\rna blizko jsou ale\rslabe.

en: \rIncreases the range\rand firepower of\rdistance weapons.
cz: \rZvysi dostrel a\rpalebnou silu\rzbrani na dalku.

en: Strong offensive and\rdefensive abilities.\rDeployment costs\rare very high.
cz: Silny v utoku\ri v obrane.\rNaklady na nasazeni\rjsou velmi vysoke.

en: \rIncreases firepower and\rdefensive ratings\rfor all units.
cz: \rZvysi palebnou silu\ri obranu\rvsech jednotek.

en: Units have great range\rof vision. Keeps unit HP\rhidden from enemies.\rIs plagued by constant\rbad luck.
cz: Jednotky maji velky dohled.\rHP jednotek zustava\rnepritelum skryte.\rProvazi ji ale stala\rsmula.

en: Extends vision range of\rall units. Shows enemy\runits hidden in woods,\rreefs and other areas.
cz: Zvysi dohled vsech jednotek.\rOdhali nepratele skryte\rv lesich, na utesech\ri jinde.

en: Strongest firepower\rin the skies. But\rflounders at sea.
cz: Nejsilnejsi palebna\rsila na nebi. Na mori\rale tapa.

en: Non-infantry units\rordered to wait can\rmove again that turn.\rHowever, their ratings\rare lower than normal.
cz: Jednotky mimo pechotu,\rktere cekaji, se mohou\rv tom tahu hnout znovu.\rJejich hodnoty jsou ale\rnizsi nez normalne.

en: The sea is his domain.\rNaval units have top\rfirepower and\rmovement. Air units\rare weak.
cz: More je jeho domov.\rNamorni jednotky maji\rspickovou silu i pohyb.\rVzdusne jednotky\rjsou slabe.

en: \rStrikes all enemy\runits for damage.
cz: \rZasahne vsechny\rnepratelske jednotky.

en: Well-balanced with no\rweak points. Born\runder a lucky star.
cz: Vyvazena, bez slabin.\rNarodila se\rpod stastnou hvezdou.

en: Mechanical wizard\rwith good all-around\rskills.
cz: Kouzelnik pres stroje\rs dobrymi vsestrannymi\rschopnostmi.

en: Gung-ho strongman.\rTops at direct\rcombat, weak\rover distances.
cz: Nadseny silak.\rSpicka v boji zblizka,\rslaby na\rvetsi vzdalenosti.

en: Easily affected by\rthe climate. Strong\rin snow, weak in rain.
cz: Snadno ho ovlivni\rpocasi. Silny ve\rsnehu, slaby v desti.

en: Infantry unit\rspecialist. Has\rtrouble with other\rground troops.
cz: Specialistka na\rpechotu. S ostatnimi\rpozemnimi jednotkami\rma potize.

en: A master of distance\rattacks. Dislikes\rdirect combat.
cz: Mistr utoku na dalku.\rBoj zblizka\rnema rad.

en: Superior overall unit\rstrength, but\rexpensive to deploy.
cz: Celkove silnejsi\rjednotky, ale drahe\rna nasazeni.

en: Tactician who values\rintel over everything.\rTops in fog of war,\rbut is often unlucky.
cz: Taktik, pro ktereho jsou\rinformace vsim. Spicka\rv Mlze valky, ale casto\rma smulu.

en: King of the skies.\rAir units are\rmatchless, but has\rweak naval units.
cz: Kral nebes. Vzdusne\rjednotky nemaji soupere,\rnamorni jsou ale\rslabe.

en: Naval units rule the\rseas, but has trouble\rwith air units. Rain\rseems to follow him.
cz: Namorni jednotky vladnou\rmori, se vzdusnymi ma ale\rpotize. Dest ho\rprovazi vsude.

en: An all-around\rpowerhouse. Units\rcan cover any terrain\rat low movement cost.
cz: Vsestranna sila.\rJeho jednotky zvladnou\rkazdy teren za nizkou\rcenu pohybu.

en: A gentle, flowing\rriver. Only infantry\runits can\rford rivers.
cz: Klidne tekouci reka.\rReku dokaze prebrodit\rjen pechota\ra mechove.

en: A steep mountain.\rInfantry units add\r3 to their vision\rrange from here.
cz: Strma hora.\rPechota zde ma\rdohled vetsi\ro 3 policka.

en: In Fog of War, units\rhidden here can only\rbe seen by adjacent\runits and air units.
cz: V Mlze valky vidi\rjednotky skryte zde\rjen sousedni jednotky\ra vzdusne jednotky.

en: A paved road.\rEasy to traverse,\rbut offers little\rdefensive cover.
cz: Zpevnena silnice.\rSnadny pruchod,\rale skoro zadny\robranny kryt.

en: A normal city.\rGround units gain\rsupplies and HP\rin allied cities.
cz: Bezne mesto.\rPozemni jednotky ve\rspojeneckych mestech\rdoplni zasoby a HP.

en: A body of water.\rOnly naval and\rair units can\rtraverse seas.
cz: Vodni plocha.\rMore prekonaji jen\rnamorni a vzdusne\rjednotky.

en: The sky is\rnot considered\rterrain.
cz: Nebe se\rza teren\rnepovazuje.

en: An air base. Allied\rbases deploy, supply\rand restore HP\rto air units.
cz: Letiste. Spojenecka\rletiste nasazuji, zasobuji\ra opravuji HP\rvzdusnych jednotek.

en: A naval base. Allied\rbases deploy, supply\rand restore HP\rto naval units.
cz: Pristav. Spojenecke\rpristavy nasazuji, zasobuji\ra opravuji HP\rnamornich jednotek.

en: A bridge allows\runits to traverse\rrivers, but offers\rno terrain benefits.
cz: Most umoznuje\rjednotkam prekonat\rreku, ale nedava\rzadne vyhody terenu.

en: A base. Allied bases\rdeploy, supply\rand restore HP\rto ground units.
cz: Zakladna. Spojenecke\rzakladny nasazuji, zasobuji\ra opravuji HP\rpozemnich jednotek.

en: In Fog of War, units\rhidden here can only\rbe seen by adjacent\runits and air units.
cz: V Mlze valky vidi\rjednotky skryte zde\rjen sousedni jednotky\ra vzdusne jednotky.

en: First, let me brief you\ron the situation.\fWe're in this large nation\rhere, Orange Star.\fThe country to the\reast is Blue Moon.\fThe two countries have been\rbitter rivals for years.\f
cz: Nejdriv vam vysvetlim,\rjak to tu vypada.\fJsme v tehle velke zemi,\rv Orange Star.\fZeme na vychod odsud\rje Blue Moon.\fTy dve zeme jsou uz roky\rzaryte soupere.\f

en: Border skirmishes had died down\rrecently...until that madman Olaf...\f
cz: Potycky na hranicich uz utichaly...\rdokud ten blazen Olaf...\f

en: Oh, excuse me. I mean, uhm...\fThe Blue Moon CO, Olaf, suddenly\rordered an invasion of Orange Star.\f
cz: Ale... prominte. Chtela jsem rict...\fVelitel Blue Moon Olaf najednou\rnaridil invazi do Orange Star.\f

en: So, the Alara region is now\rheld by Blue Moon forces.\f
cz: Region Alara tak ted drzi\rjednotky Blue Moon.\f
